description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ballapana -  Udabage, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610008
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications) in various villages, making it primarily concerned with land and property-related matters. The content falls under the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
